title: Zorker OpenLink — Build in Context
narrative: One developer task, followed from brief through work, result, refinement, and review.

visualRules.canvas: White, high-key typography shots; native light-theme OpenLink UI for product shots.
visualRules.camera: Continuous lateral tracking in the opening; locked UI stages; one lateral title-to-workspace wipe; hard cuts between acts.
visualRules.focus: One reading target per beat. No blur, stock footage, 3D render, fake integrations, or copied ChatGPT marks.
visualRules.productCopy: No editorial headline over settled product UI. Small illustrative-workflow disclosure remains visible on product shots.
visualRules.evidence: The UI uses deterministic fixtures and is disclosed as illustrative, time-compressed workflow.

shots.title: 01 · Who builds
shots.purpose: Widen the audience, then introduce the product in one continuous lateral move.
shots.camera: Constant leftward track over a white world canvas.

shots.title: 02 · Thesis
shots.purpose: State the film's claim before proving it.
shots.copy: Every good build starts with a clear brief.

shots.title: 03 · The brief
shots.purpose: Type and submit the existing Forma landing-page brief in the real extracted home composer.
shots.camera: Native input framing, measured typing front, one send click.

shots.title: 04 · The work
shots.purpose: Show the visible conversation, task rows, completed reply, and file-change card in order.
shots.camera: One top-to-bottom scan, then a readable completed state.

shots.title: 05 · The result
shots.purpose: Let the initial website preview register before the revision.
shots.camera: Stable product view with restrained camera movement.

shots.title: 06 · Inspect the change
shots.purpose: Move from a short white-space statement to the source-derived file-change card.
shots.camera: Statement holds first; a single card rises and settles.

shots.title: 07 · Refine
shots.purpose: Send the existing follow-up that changes the Forma palette while preserving its layout.
shots.camera: Track the second typing front and land on the submit feedback.

shots.title: 08 · One workspace
shots.purpose: Show the actual split conversation-and-preview workspace as one connected view.
shots.camera: One lateral wipe: title exits frame-left as the source UI enters from frame-right; UI settles before its internal entrance animation.

shots.title: 09 · Make it yours
shots.purpose: Show the same illustrative site changing from warm neutrals to electric blue, with identical structure and content.
shots.camera: One 1.5-second cross-dissolve between matched source-UI states, followed by a hold.

shots.title: 10 · Review the project
shots.purpose: Prove component inspection, code-diff viewing, and version selection through native UI states.
shots.camera: Three concise, motivated inserts; cursor marks the control and its visible feedback.

shots.title: 11 · Brand close
shots.purpose: Return to the Zorker OpenLink mark and leave a clean end hold.
shots.camera: Locked typography, then the existing logo lockup on white.

limitations: The Forma website, conversation events, displayed source changes, and version state are deterministic illustrative demo fixtures, not a live agent or provider run.
No Snowflake, Tableau, Teams, data-dashboard, publishing, or external sharing capability is claimed.
This composition is an adaptation of the supplied creative template, not a recreation of ChatGPT branding or product UI.
